text:
nina: quick sync on the onboarding flow tradeoffs 1 - thinking of a "light gate" at ingest (tokenizer + shape + tiny smoke gold ~40 items) and pushing the heavy suite async. want to capture required signals and failure modes.

arslan: fine with async bench but want an explicit lifecycle and clear invariants: no model should be routed to >shadow traffic until bench reports PASS or explicit human override. otherwise we need auto-rollback rules.

tara: propose states: raw_ingest -> smoke_ok -> queued_for_full_bench -> verifying -> shadow -> canary -> promoted | quarantined | rejected. each transition must emit an event with reason + golden_ref.

nina: good. what does the intake response look like? sketch: ingest returns candidate_id, smoke_summary, golden_probe_id, and estimated bench ETA. the candidate metadata must persist golden_probe_id so bench and runtime agree.

arslan: operational concerns: bench quota per org, max concurrent bench jobs, and a TTL for queued jobs (e.g., 48h) after which it becomes stale and requires manual review. if bench backlog is high, intake should either queue + notify or require manual approval.

bench-bot: bench queued: candidate=cand-1768888889, est_gpu_hours=3.6, expected_done=~7h; webhook=/hooks/bench/result. queue_depth=5.

tara: API/webhook payload should be compact. include verdict enum (pass|warn|fail), failed_test_ids[], drift_score (0..1), p95_ms, golden_ref, bench_run_id, summary_url. example:```json
{
  "candidate_id": "cand-1768888889",
  "verdict": "warn",
  "failed_test_ids": ["regression:qa-2026-04"],
  "drift_score": "0.27",
  "p95_ms": "320",
  "golden_ref": "gold-2026-04-01-a",
  "bench_run_id": "bench-9911",
  "summary_url": "https://bench.internal/r/bench-9911"
}
```

arslan: intake should validate golden_ref echoes candidate metadata and reject results that mismatch. bench should also attach a tiny "delta summary" in-line (1-3 bullet points) so the webhook is actionable without loading artifacts.

nina: agree. rollout recipe: after pass -> shadow 24h (no responses served), then canary 0.1% for 30m, 1% for 2h, 5% for 6h. any bench WARN or new telemetry spike pauses promotion.

tara: add prefiltering: before enqueuing full bench, run tokenization-hash, simple-embed-sanity, and smoke-gold check. if prefilter fails, avoid wasting bench cycles and move candidate to rejected/quarantine.

ops-bot: ops knobs: org_gpu_quota (daily), candidate_gpu_cap, bench_priority_tiers, pending_ttl, auto_stale_window. provide console visibility and an "expedite" request with audit trail.

arslan: define actions on bench verdicts: pass -> schedule shadow; warn -> quarantined_with_reasons + notify owner + option to re-run with diff golden; fail -> immediate quarantine and if any traffic routed, auto-rollback + incident ticket creation.

nina: how do we version golden sets? store golden_ref and a content-hash for the probe set in model metadata. runtime should require golden_ref present to allow promotion. bench must echo golden_ref back in webhook.

tara: metrics to collect: time_in_state, bench_queue_latency, per-org_gpu_spend, quarantines_by_org, false_reject_rate of smoke probe, and post-promotion regressions. these drive alerts and quota adjustments.

bench-bot: bench verdict posted for cand-1768888889: verdict=warn, failed_test_ids=["regression:qa-2026-04"], drift_score=0.27, p95_ms=318, golden_ref=gold-2026-04-01-a, bench_run_id=bench-9911, summary_url=https://bench.internal/r/bench-9911

arslan: for WARN we should block promotion (no canary) and label candidate quarantined_pending_owner_action; allow owner to request rebench or provide updated golden_ref. we need a simple UI action: "rebench with N" or "promote with override (audit)".

nina: i'll draft a concise RFC: state machine diagram, ingest API, bench webhook schema, TTLs/quota rules, prefilter checklist, rollout recipe, and console UX for rebench/override. reviewers: ars lan for ops, tara for bench schema, bench infra for cost numbers, and sysops for runbook.

tara: i'll prepare the smoke-gold (40-60 examples) and tokenization-hash utilities.

ops-bot: note: bench_median_wait=1.3h, mean_run=5.0h, current_queue_depth=5.

nina: thanks all 1 please review when I post the RFC later today.
